newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Cimpor gains in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Cimpor gains in heavy trade.

text.p: Cement company Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal was gaining 1.9 percent at 3,700 escudos in heavy trade of over 850,000 shares, buoyed by the good prospects for the sector, belief the stock price can rise further and the coming dividend payment, traders said.

"Cimpor is worth more than this (current price) because of the growth prospects for the building sector in 1997 and the fact it had lost ground since January," said one trader who asked not to be named.
Another trader said that there was a single foreign investor who was buying strongly.
